title: Sam and Anna
text:
Sam likes sports. He runs fast every morning. He jumps over the box and kicks the ball. Then he drinks water.

Anna is his sister. She writes in her notebook and draws a picture. Sam watches her. Anna smiles and says hello.

questions.text: What does Sam do every morning?
What does Anna do in her notebook?
How does Anna probably feel when Sam watches her?

vocabulary.definition: moves on your feet quickly, faster than walking
pushes your body up and off the ground with your legs
moves your mouth up to show that you are happy or friendly

paragraph_translations: Sam lubi sport. Co rano biega szybko. Przeskakuje przez pudełko i kopie piłkę. Potem pije wodę.
Anna jest jego siostrą. Pisze w swoim zeszycie i rysuje obrazek. Sam ją obserwuje. Anna uśmiecha się i mówi cześć.
